film.caption: One room. Six voices.
film.description: A sixteen-second native ensemble, then six individual voices. Offline studio synthesis and ink, not headset footage or a spatial-audio demonstration. No microphone input or user recordings.

modules.name: Private Ritual
modules.soundDescription: Private Ritual: A steady low kick, crisp backbeats and short offbeat hats hold a repeating dance pulse.

modules.name: Below Thought
modules.soundDescription: Below Thought: Rounded low notes repeat a syncopated bass pattern, with occasional higher answers.

modules.name: What We Keep
modules.soundDescription: What We Keep: A held chord gently pulses with the beat while its brightness changes.

modules.name: Restless Tongue
modules.soundDescription: Restless Tongue: A resonant, buzzing sequence repeats with accents and sliding notes.

modules.name: Small Doubts
modules.soundDescription: Small Doubts: Clear high notes leave space between short repeating melodic answers.

modules.name: Open Window
modules.soundDescription: Open Window: Filtered air slowly rises and recedes across a four-bar breath.

provenance: The opening is a downmix of the real production AudioGraph preview. Portraits use six production synths on the shared musical clock. Native PixelCanvas drawings and the website's procedural pen alphabet. Studio presentation, not app screenshots or a headset spatial mix.
